title: Pack Icon
description: Validates behavior and resource pack icons (pack_icon.png) for correct format, size, and placement. The icon is shown in the pack selection screens.

101.title: Missing Icon
101.description: Warning when no pack_icon.png file is found in the pack root. A pack icon helps players identify your content.
101.x-runtime-constraint-description: Data contains the pack path missing the icon

102.title: Multiple Icons
102.description: Warning when multiple pack icon files are found. Only one pack_icon.png should exist in each pack root.
102.x-runtime-constraint-description: Data contains the paths to the multiple icon files

103.title: Invalid Format
103.description: Error when the pack icon file is not a valid PNG image. Ensure the file is properly formatted.
103.x-runtime-constraint-description: Data contains the path to the invalid icon file

104.title: Invalid Size
104.description: Warning when the pack icon is not the expected dimensions. Pack icons should be square (typically 256x256 pixels for best display).
104.x-runtime-constraint-description: Data contains the actual dimensions found
